Economy · World

Global Markets React to Rising Oil Prices and Geopolitical Tensions

Global stock markets experienced declines as elevated crude oil prices weighed on investor sentiment. Treasury yields showed volatility, rising alongside oil prices and amid fears of inflation and Middle East tensions. In the US, nonfarm payrolls fell in July, though the unemployment rate eased to 4.1%. Meanwhile, the tightened blockade on Gaza caused prices to soar, and discussions emerged about the survival of Iran's middle class in a post-war economy. The Iran conflict also led to a US arsenal drain and a surge in electric motorcycle sales.
